title: Hahn splits the atom in 1938
summary: Robert Salas tells of Hahn splits the atom in 1938, about 1938 at Germany, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: That was um uh happened to be a Nazi scientist by the name of um Han I think uh who did an experiment in 1938 and uh was first uh to split the atom.

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer who tells of UFOs at nuclear missile sites, mentions in passing that a German scientist he names as Hahn, whom he calls a Nazi scientist, did an experiment in 1938 and was the first to split the atom. Salas brings it up as the start of the nuclear age, which in his account is what drew UFO interest to nuclear weapons.
